text: Leo and Mang Ben arrived at the Luntian plaza this afternoon.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Leo, it's afternoon. What greeting is fitting for this afternoon at the plaza?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Great job! Are you ready to talk with the villagers?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: It's afternoon now, so GOOD AFTERNOON is more appropriate. Do you understand?
Mang Ben nodded, and they stepped into the lively and bustling plaza.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Don't worry. We'll take our conversations slowly here.
